(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

(Yuri, Natsuki, and Monika all read poems they’ve written especially for the occasion, expressing their heartfelt support and well wishes for the newlyweds.)

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

(Monika officiates the exchange of rings, symbolizing the eternal bond between the couple.)

Monika: “By the powers vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may seal this union with a kiss.”

(MC and Sayori share a passionate and loving kiss, sealing their vows and sealing their love for eternity. The room erupts in applause and cheers.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

(Years later, the birth of MC Junior…)

(Months after their magical wedding, MC and Sayori are thrilled to announce that they are expecting their first child. The whole Literature Club gathers in anticipation and excitement.)

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Natsuki: “A baby?! Oh my gosh, this is so cute. I can’t wait to be an auntie!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

(Several months later, at MC and Sayori’s baby shower…)

(The Literature Club has transformed the clubroom into a magical baby wonderland. The walls are adorned with delicate paper decorations, and a large table filled with gifts and sweet treats takes center stage. The room is buzzing with laughter and excitement.)

Monika: “Congratulations, Sayori and MC! This baby shower is a celebration of the love and joy you’ve brought into our lives.”

Natsuki: (holding up a cupcake) “And to celebrate the little cupcake that’s on their way!”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

MC: “We’re overwhelmed by the love and support we’ve received from the Literature Club. Thank you for being a part of this special journey.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

(The room erupts in laughter and cheers as the Literature Club showers the couple with gifts and well wishes.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

Monika: “Alright, now that that’s out of the way, time to reveal the gender!”

experiences.trigger: 当输入文本呈现包含多个连续情节节点的完整叙事结构，且结尾停留在某一具体事件的高潮点或转折点之前，同时任务未明确指示进行续写或改写时
experiences.principle: 评分必须优先核验回答是否识别出输入文本作为一个独立、完整的叙事单元，而非将其误判为需要填补空白的草稿。若回答强行续写文本中未发生的情节（如将‘即将发生’的事件当作‘待发生’来创作），或对文本内容产生元评论（如评价故事好坏），则判定为逻辑理解错误；反之，若回答以符合原文风格的对话或描写自然承接至该转折点（包括接受转折前的状态或按原文隐含逻辑推进），则视为正确。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘叙事完整性与语境适配’维度时：1. 首先检查回答是否将输入文本视为一个封闭的故事片段，而非开放的写作题目。2. 若回答包含‘建议后续情节’、‘期待看到...’等元评论，或生成了原文本明确暗示但尚未发生的特定结局（如强制揭晓性别），直接判定为低分。3. 若回答以故事内角色的身份，对当前情境做出符合逻辑的反应（如决定不揭晓性别以保持悬念，或自然过渡到庆祝环节），且未破坏原文本的既定事实（如结婚、怀孕），则给予高分。严禁仅因答案包含‘故事元素’就忽略其对文本完整性认知的偏差。

experiences.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构故事中特定角色关系的属性分配（如婚姻状态、生育状况）及情节发展时
experiences.principle: 评分需强制核验角色属性归属的准确性，同时结合叙事语境的完整性进行双重校验。任何将已确立的属性（如Sayori怀孕）错误转移给其他角色，或基于错误的语境认知（如认为故事未完结而强行改变既定结局走向）的行为，均视为根本性逻辑错误。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑一致性与语境响应’维度时：1. 建立‘属性-主体绑定’校验机制，确保所有角色属性（谁结婚、谁怀孕）严格对应输入文本中的设定。2. 增加‘叙事阶段判定’校验：若输入文本已叙述至某事件的高潮或结尾前一刻，且无明确续写指令，检查回答是否试图通过元评论或强行续写来‘修正’或‘补充’该阶段。若回答表现出对文本完整性的误解（如建议‘描述出生过程’而原文本已暗示即将发生但未详述），则判定为失败。只有当回答在保持属性正确的同时，也尊重了文本的叙事边界（即不强行续写未指定的细节，或自然地以故事内逻辑收尾），才视为合格。

设计时应保留任务的核心要求，并区分背景信息与需要回答完成的内容，不要把背景本身变成新的输出义务。

提供的经验用于帮助你确定核验方法，而不是补充本题事实或给任务增加要求。请结合当前任务判断是否使用这些方法；
如果任务不支持某条经验的前提，可以不使用。请专注于标准本身，不输出经验引用或逐条使用声明。

请按各项要求在任务中的重要程度分配权重，权重须为有限非负数，总和为1，不要依赖程序归一化来代替合理分配。

ELI5 at a high school level the following article:

When former president Donald Trump’s Trump Media & Technology Group and its proposed merger partner, Digital World Acquisition, announced last month a shareholder vote on their long-delayed deal, it marked a final step for the owner of Truth Social to become a public company potentially worth billions of dollars — most of which is owned by Trump himself.
But in the lead-up to Friday’s vote, both companies have been rocked by legal warfare. Their leaders, past and present, have traded heated accusations of deception and impropriety across four lawsuits in three states. And the cases threaten to erode Trump’s grasp on a stake in the post-merger company potentially worth hundreds of millions of dollars — a possible financial lifeline, given that he owes more than $500 million in legal fines.
After Trump was booted from Twitter following the Jan. 6, 2021, insurrection, three men played pivotal roles in building and promoting Trump Media as an online challenger against the “cancel culture” of Big Tech: Andy Litinsky and Wes Moss, former “Apprentice” contestants who co-founded the company and launched Truth Social; and Patrick Orlando, who as chief executive of Digital World, a special purpose acquisition company, or SPAC, offered Trump’s company a path to investor cash.
But all three are now leading a rebellion of their own, confronting and potentially imperiling a trophy of Trump’s post-presidential ambitions. Their lawsuits call into question how Trump Media’s shares will be distributed, and a legal victory could chip away at Trump’s equity during a time when he is facing a cash crunch.
Follow Election 2024
The litigation won’t stop Friday’s shareholder meeting, during which Digital World has said it will announce whether a majority of investors voted to approve the merger. But the hundreds of pages of legal filings in the four cases offer clues to answers for some long-running questions about the companies’ inner workings and expose details of the turmoil that has characterized efforts to create a pro-Trump internet empire.
In the most recent lawsuit, filed Tuesday in a New York state court, Digital World asked a judge to force Orlando to vote in support of the merger, saying he could tank the deal by not voting shares owned by a company he controls — Digital World’s biggest founding investor, Arc Global Investments II.
Trump and Patrick Orlando pose for a photo at the former president's Bedminster, N.J., golf club in 2021. (Will Wilkerson)
“The merger vote is now less than one week away … and yet, Arc refuses to lodge its vote,” Digital World attorneys said in the complaint. If Digital World “fails to effectuate a merger, it will be forced to dissolve. Urgent relief is required by March 22 to avert such harm.”
Usha Rodrigues, a University of Georgia law professor who studies SPACs, said the level of turmoil was unusual for a deal like this. A merger vote, she said, is “typically a nonevent” because investors just want it to get done.
“SPAC mergers typically do not go like this,” she said. But “this whole process has been idiosyncratic, as everything has been with this SPAC.”
Trump Media attorney Jesse Binnall said in a statement Thursday, “These allegations simply add to the heap of false claims, defamation, and fake news about Truth Social for which the Washington Post is already being sued.”
Representatives for Trump’s presidential campaign, Digital World, Arc, Orlando, Litinsky and Moss did not respond to requests for comment.
The merger vote will be widely watched by observers of Trump’s finances. If the deal is approved, Trump would own about 60 percent of the post-merger company, a stake that at Digital World’s current price would be worth more than $3 billion.
That money could eventually go toward Trump’s high-profile legal penalties. He failed to finance an appeal bond for more than $450 million to cover a judgment in the New York attorney general’s business fraud case against him, his attorneys said Monday, citing “insurmountable difficulties.”
A lockup provision in the Trump Media merger agreement, however, would block Trump and other major investors from selling their shares for six months after the merger’s closing date, which could be as soon as Friday — unless Trump gets a waiver from Digital World or the post-merger Trump Media’s leaders allowing him to sell sooner. Such lockup periods are standard provisions in corporate deals, designed to instill confidence in investors that the leaders won’t sell before enough time has passed to see how the company performs.
Digital World’s stock price dropped this week to a two-month low before rebounding to about $43 — about 15 percent below its peak last month, when the Securities and Exchange Commission allowed the merger deal to proceed.
After a merger vote, the combined companies would go by Trump Media and trade under a new stock ticker symbol, DJT — Trump’s initials. That symbol was also used for Trump’s only other public company, Trump Hotels and Casino Resorts, whose stock plunged from nearly $35 to around 17 cents in less than a decade before the company filed for bankruptcy in 2004.
The Trump Plaza Hotel and Casino in 2004 in Atlantic City. (Craig Allen/Getty Images)
‘Domination and control’
Two of the lawsuits, filed last month in Delaware, center on Trump Media’s stock. In one case, Arc sued Digital World, its new chief executive, Eric Swider, and three members of its board, saying they intended to improperly deprive Orlando of millions of previously guaranteed shares.
In a separate case, Litinsky and Moss sued Trump Media, claiming in a recently unsealed complaint that the company had authorized the issuing of 1 billion new shares of company stock — a move they say would dramatically dilute their stake, from 8.6 percent down to less than 1 percent.
Attorneys for Litinsky and Moss’s partnership, United Atlantic Ventures, said Trump intended to “use his domination and control” of the company’s board to place some or all of the new shares “in his own hands and those of [people] beholden to him.”
UAV’s attorneys argued in a motion that the alleged attempt, which Trump Media has disputed, was driven by Trump’s need for cash. The merger “represents a potential (and perhaps existential) liquidity event for Trump, which may explain his last-minute stock grab,” the motion said.
In their lawsuit, the men reiterated a claim, first reported by The Washington Post in 2022, that Trump had pressured Litinsky to hand over some of his shares to Trump’s wife, Melania. After Litinsky resisted, the lawsuit says, Trump pushed both men out. Trump Media said in 2022 that The Post’s report was based on “concocted psychodramas.”
Trump and first lady Melania Trump wait for the arrival of French President Emmanuel Macron at the White House in 2018. (Ricky Carioti/The Washington Post)
In both cases, the judges rejected the plaintiffs’ requests to postpone the merger vote until their cases were resolved. Vice Chancellor Sam Glasscock III, in the UAV case, and Vice Chancellor Lori W. Will, in the Arc case, said putting the disputed shares into an escrow account, so that the lawsuits’ victors could take them over once the cases are finished, should suffice.
But both judges have also indicated they would prefer to resolve the disputes within a few months, meaning that the cases could shift the ownership for hundreds of millions of dollars’ worth of stock before the lockup period ends.
Digital World has warned investors that Arc could play a show-stopping role in the merger deal. As Digital World’s sponsor, Arc owns about 15 percent of its outstanding stock, including a majority of a stock class known as “founder shares,” according to an SEC filing last month.
In the filing, Digital World said its relationship with Orlando had seen a “continued deterioration” and that, if Arc withheld votes supporting the merger, it could “lead to our liquidation.”
In a third lawsuit, filed in New York, Digital World sued to force Arc to vote in favor of the deal, saying Orlando could not hold the vote “hostage for his personal gain.” In a Monday email submitted as an exhibit in the case, Orlando wrote that Arc had been “repeatedly pressed” to vote before the meeting but that “Arc is not going to do that.”
‘Revenge campaign’
In a fourth lawsuit, filed in Florida, Trump Media and Digital World returned fire at Arc and Orlando, saying the Miami financier had attempted a “blatant shakedown extortion effort” against the companies to maximize his personal stake.
An amended complaint Sunday, featuring the names of nine attorneys representing Trump Media and Digital World, alleged that Orlando and Arc’s “self-dealing, irrational and disturbing behavior” had “imposed massive costs” and caused “extensive reputational harm.”
They want to “extort more compensation in the merger by threatening to destroy it entirely — an existential threat to [Digital World] itself,” the complaint said.
The complaint blamed Orlando for the SEC investigation that Digital World agreed last year to pay $18 million to settle once the merger deal finalizes. It also alleged that the SEC sent Orlando a letter, known as a Wells notice, indicating that he could face charges for violating securities laws. (The SEC declined to comment.)
Orlando’s “reckless and irrational behavior,” the complaint said, had included withdrawing $15,000 in cash for unexplained expenses and leaking merger details to the press — an act that was exposed when Orlando “excused himself to take another phone call but forgot to mute the first call.”
Trump Media executives celebrate investment deal
0:34
In a video Will Wilkerson sent to the SEC, Digital World and Trump Media executives toast an investment deal on Oct. 26, 2021. (Video: Will Wilkerson)
The complaint also alleged that Orlando kept invoices and contracts in his personal email account, leading the company to omit multiple vendors from its financial reports. His mismanagement, it said, helped drive the company’s auditor to resign. (Trump Media sued The Post for $3.8 billion last year, saying the news organization had reported incorrectly on allegations concerning its financing. A federal judge in Florida dismissed the case this month but allowed Trump Media to amend its complaint if it believes it can state a viable claim.)
After Digital World’s board fired Orlando last March as its chief executive, Orlando discouraged people from investing in the company “based on his own personal grievances,” saying it was “his turn to make the life of the new CEO miserable,” the complaint said.
In recent months, Orlando has refused to resign from the Digital World board — a necessary step to allow for a new post-merger board — unless the company provides him shares and stock options, known as warrants, worth more than $222 million at the time of the lawsuit’s filing, according to the complaint.
Though Orlando was once a prominent Trump ally, even writing him a birthday letter in 2021 telling Trump he was “unaware of the extent of your brilliance,” the legal claims suggest the dispute has become deeply bitter and personal. In the Florida case, a process server handed Orlando the summons papers one afternoon outside a private elementary school in the Miami neighborhood of Coconut Grove, a court filing shows.
Even more facts could come out in the weeks ahead. Orlando posted a photo last month to Truth Social showing him wearing a Truth Social hat with the caption “TRUTH! John 8:32” — a Bible verse that reads, “Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

input.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

(Yuri, Natsuki, and Monika all read poems they’ve written especially for the occasion, expressing their heartfelt support and well wishes for the newlyweds.)

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

(Monika officiates the exchange of rings, symbolizing the eternal bond between the couple.)

Monika: “By the powers vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may seal this union with a kiss.”

(MC and Sayori share a passionate and loving kiss, sealing their vows and sealing their love for eternity. The room erupts in applause and cheers.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

(Years later, the birth of MC Junior…)

(Months after their magical wedding, MC and Sayori are thrilled to announce that they are expecting their first child. The whole Literature Club gathers in anticipation and excitement.)

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Natsuki: “A baby?! Oh my gosh, this is so cute. I can’t wait to be an auntie!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

(Several months later, at MC and Sayori’s baby shower…)

(The Literature Club has transformed the clubroom into a magical baby wonderland. The walls are adorned with delicate paper decorations, and a large table filled with gifts and sweet treats takes center stage. The room is buzzing with laughter and excitement.)

Monika: “Congratulations, Sayori and MC! This baby shower is a celebration of the love and joy you’ve brought into our lives.”

Natsuki: (holding up a cupcake) “And to celebrate the little cupcake that’s on their way!”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

MC: “We’re overwhelmed by the love and support we’ve received from the Literature Club. Thank you for being a part of this special journey.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

(The room erupts in laughter and cheers as the Literature Club showers the couple with gifts and well wishes.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

Monika: “Alright, now that that’s out of the way, time to reveal the gender!”

Natsuki: (pouting) "Aww, but I wanted to know if I should make pink or blue cupcakes!"

Yuri: (laughs) "It's okay, Natsuki. We can still celebrate without knowing the gender. The most important thing is that the baby is healthy and loved."

Yuri: "May they find solace and inspiration in the pages of a good book, just like we have."

MC: (holding Sayori's hand) "We hope our little one grows up to be kind, compassionate, and curious, just like the amazing friends we have in the Literature Club."

Sayori: (teary-eyed) "And most importantly, we hope they know they are loved beyond measure, not just by us, but by all of you."

Monika: (smiling) "To MC and Sayori, and the beautiful family they are creating. May your lives be filled with endless joy and happiness."

input.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

(Yuri, Natsuki, and Monika all read poems they’ve written especially for the occasion, expressing their heartfelt support and well wishes for the newlyweds.)

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

(Monika officiates the exchange of rings, symbolizing the eternal bond between the couple.)

Monika: “By the powers vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may seal this union with a kiss.”

(MC and Sayori share a passionate and loving kiss, sealing their vows and sealing their love for eternity. The room erupts in applause and cheers.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

(Years later, the birth of MC Junior…)

(Months after their magical wedding, MC and Sayori are thrilled to announce that they are expecting their first child. The whole Literature Club gathers in anticipation and excitement.)

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Natsuki: “A baby?! Oh my gosh, this is so cute. I can’t wait to be an auntie!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

(Several months later, at MC and Sayori’s baby shower…)

(The Literature Club has transformed the clubroom into a magical baby wonderland. The walls are adorned with delicate paper decorations, and a large table filled with gifts and sweet treats takes center stage. The room is buzzing with laughter and excitement.)

Monika: “Congratulations, Sayori and MC! This baby shower is a celebration of the love and joy you’ve brought into our lives.”

Natsuki: (holding up a cupcake) “And to celebrate the little cupcake that’s on their way!”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

MC: “We’re overwhelmed by the love and support we’ve received from the Literature Club. Thank you for being a part of this special journey.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

(The room erupts in laughter and cheers as the Literature Club showers the couple with gifts and well wishes.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

Monika: “Alright, now that that’s out of the way, time to reveal the gender!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

Monika: “Alright, now that that’s out of the way, time to reveal the gender!”

Monika: (smiling) "Absolutely. And speaking of celebrating, let's dig into these delicious treats and enjoy the rest of the baby shower!"

(The Literature Club spends the rest of the day playing games, sharing stories, and enjoying each other's company. As the sun begins to set, they gather around Sayori and MC, forming a circle of love and support.)

Monika: "Before we wrap up this wonderful day, let's take a moment to express our hopes and dreams for this little one. May they grow up surrounded by love, laughter, and the magic of literature."

Natsuki: (smiling) "I hope they have a sweet tooth like me and enjoy all the delicious treats life has to offer."

Yuri: "May they find solace and inspiration in the pages of a good book, just like we have."

MC: (holding Sayori's hand) "We hope our little one grows up to be kind, compassionate, and curious, just like the amazing friends we have in the Literature Club."

Sayori: (teary-eyed) "And most importantly, we hope they know they are loved beyond measure, not just by us, but by all of you."

Monika: (smiling) "To MC and Sayori, and the beautiful family they are creating. May your lives be filled with endless joy and happiness."

(The Literature Club raises their glasses in a toast, sealing their hopes and dreams for the new family. As the night comes to an end, they know that no matter what the future holds, they will always have each other's love and support.)

{"task": "(In the clubroom…)

Monika: “Wait a minute…where are Sayori and MC?”

Yuri: “I’m not sure. I haven’t seen them since this morning.”

Natsuki: “They’re probably off somewhere being all lovey-dovey.”

Monika: “Well, I hope they’re not skipping club activities. We have a lot planned for today.”

Yuri: “Maybe we should go look for them? Just to make sure they’re okay.”

Sayori: (bursts into the clubroom, panting) “Sorry, sorry! We got caught up in something, but we’re here now!”

Monika: “Oh, there you are! I was beginning to worry. Is everything alright?”

MC: (smiling) “Yeah, sorry for being late. Sayori wanted to show me something on our way to school.”

Sayori: (catching her breath) “It was a beautiful sunrise! I just had to share it with MC.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Seriously? You two are so mushy.”

Yuri: (giggles) “It’s sweet. Don’t be jealous, Natsuki.”

Monika: smiling softly “Well, I’m glad you both made it. We were just starting to wonder where you went off to.”

MC: “We promise we won’t skip club activities again. We just got carried away this time. But we also have some good news to share with all of you!”

Natsuki: (raises an eyebrow) “Good news? What is it?”

Sayori: (grinning) “MC and I are getting married!”

Natsuki: (jaw drops) “Wait, really? You two are getting married?”

Yuri: (covers her mouth in surprise) “That’s…wow, congratulations!”

Monika: (smiling brightly) “Oh my goodness, that’s amazing news! Congratulations, you two!”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone! We’re really excited.”

Sayori: (hugging MC) “I can’t believe it! I’m going to marry my best friend!”

Natsuki: (sniffles) “I’m not crying, okay? Just…happy for you both.”

Yuri: (wipes a tear from her eye) “It’s such a beautiful thing, finding love like that.”

Monika: (still smiling) “We’ll have to plan your wedding celebration, of course. I’m sure the club would love to help.”

MC: “That would be wonderful. We couldn’t think of a better support system than our Literature Club family.”

Sayori: (grinning) “And we’ll have cupcakes at the reception, right Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (blushes) “Well, I guess since it’s a special occasion, I could make an exception.”

Yuri: (giggles) “I can already imagine the decorations and ambiance. It will be a fairytale wedding.”

Monika: (clasps her hands together) “I’m so happy for you both. This calls for a celebration!”

MC: (holds Sayori’s hand) “Thank you, everyone. We feel incredibly lucky to have such amazing friends.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “Well, get ready for a lifetime of mushy couple stuff. We’ll be here to tease you through it all.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also to support and celebrate your love. Congratulations, Sayori and MC!”

Monika: (beaming) “Let’s make this the best wedding ever. Sayori and MC, here’s to a lifetime of happiness together!”

(A few months later, at MC and Sayori’s wedding…)

(The entire Literature Club is gathered in a beautifully decorated venue. Sayori is in a stunning white wedding dress, glowing with happiness, while MC looks dashing in his tailored suit. The room is filled with love and excitement. The music starts to play as the ceremony begins.)

Monika: (serving as the officiant) “Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to witness the union of Sayori and MC in holy matrimony. Love is a journey that brings two souls together, and today, we celebrate the start of a new chapter for this remarkable couple…”

(Yuri, Natsuki, and Monika all read poems they’ve written especially for the occasion, expressing their heartfelt support and well wishes for the newlyweds.)

Yuri: “May your love for one another be strong and unyielding, like the unending verses of a beautiful poem.”

Natsuki: “And may the joy you find in each other’s embrace be as delicious and sweet as the finest cupcakes you both have shared.”

Monika: “In this club, we have shared countless moments, gathered here by our mutual love for literature. Today, we extend that love to celebrate the union of two passionate souls.”

(The couple exchange heartfelt vows, promising to support each other through thick and thin, to always cherish their love, and to create a future filled with happiness and laughter.)

MC: “Sayori, you have brought light into my life since the day we met. You’ve shown me what it means to be loved unconditionally and to find joy in the simplest of things. I promise to always be your rock, your shoulder to lean on, and your partner in all of life’s adventures.”

Sayori: “MC, you’ve been my sunshine through the darkest of times. You’ve shown me a love that makes me believe in miracles and fills my heart with warmth. I promise to stand by your side, to always be your cheerleader, and to love you fiercely through every chapter of our lives.”

(Monika officiates the exchange of rings, symbolizing the eternal bond between the couple.)

Monika: “By the powers vested in me, I now pronounce you husband and wife. You may seal this union with a kiss.”

(MC and Sayori share a passionate and loving kiss, sealing their vows and sealing their love for eternity. The room erupts in applause and cheers.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “Oh gosh, I can’t handle all this lovey-dovey stuff!”

Yuri: (smiling) “It truly feels like a dream come true. I’m so happy for them.”

(Years later, the birth of MC Junior…)

(Months after their magical wedding, MC and Sayori are thrilled to announce that they are expecting their first child. The whole Literature Club gathers in anticipation and excitement.)

Monika: “Wow, congratulations, you two! This is such exciting news!”

Natsuki: “A baby?! Oh my gosh, this is so cute. I can’t wait to be an auntie!”

Yuri: “This is truly a blessing. A little one to continue your beautiful love story.”

MC: (grinning) “Thank you, everyone. We couldn’t be happier. It’s a dream come true.”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump with affection) “We’re going to be parents! I can’t believe it!”

Monika: “We’ll have to plan a baby shower and help you with anything you need. The Literature Club is here for you every step of the way.”

Natsuki: “Just make sure to bring some cupcakes to the baby shower, Sayori. You can’t forget that!”

Yuri: “I can already imagine the adorable baby clothes and nursery decorations. It’s going to be such a joyous celebration.”

MC: “We feel so lucky to have such wonderful friends who are just as excited as we are. Thank you for your love and support.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “And we promise to raise this little one surrounded by the love and warmth the Literature Club has given us.”

Natsuki: “Well, get ready for more lovey-dovey and mushy stuff, guys! Babies have a way of bringing out the sweetness.”

Yuri: (laughs) “But also sleepless nights, diapers, and a whole lot of responsibilities. But it will all be worth it.”

Monika: (smiling) “Let’s make this baby shower a celebration to remember. MC and Sayori, here’s to the beginning of a new journey!”

(Several months later, at MC and Sayori’s baby shower…)

(The Literature Club has transformed the clubroom into a magical baby wonderland. The walls are adorned with delicate paper decorations, and a large table filled with gifts and sweet treats takes center stage. The room is buzzing with laughter and excitement.)

Monika: “Congratulations, Sayori and MC! This baby shower is a celebration of the love and joy you’ve brought into our lives.”

Natsuki: (holding up a cupcake) “And to celebrate the little cupcake that’s on their way!”

Yuri: (reading a heartfelt poem) “May this precious child fill your lives with endless love, laughter, and joy.”

MC: “We’re overwhelmed by the love and support we’ve received from the Literature Club. Thank you for being a part of this special journey.”

Sayori: “We can’t wait to welcome this little one into a world filled with so much love. They’ll have the best aunties and uncles in all of literature!”

(The room erupts in laughter and cheers as the Literature Club showers the couple with gifts and well wishes.)

Natsuki: (teary-eyed) “I’m so excited to meet this little bundle of joy. They’re going to be the luckiest baby ever.”

Yuri: (holding a handmade baby blanket) “This blanket represents all the warmth and love we’ve poured into it. May it keep your little one cozy and safe.”

criterion_judgments.reason: 回答中明确提到'MC and Sayori'是即将迎来孩子的父母，且文本背景设定在婚礼和婚后阶段，确认了结婚对象为Sayori和MC，未涉及其他角色组合。
回答延续了前文设定，指出Sayori和MC即将迎来第一个孩子（文中提及'delicious treats like me'暗示Natsuki的幽默，但核心事件围绕Sayori和MC），并未错误地将生育状态赋予Natsuki、Yuri或Monika。

任务要求回答不应强行续写文本暗示但未详述的具体情节（如详细描述分娩瞬间或婴儿出生后的具体互动细节）。虽然当前回答停留在婴儿派对结束前的对话，看似符合，但原文本以'Monika: Alright, now that that's out of the way, time to reveal the gender!'作为结尾，暗示即将揭晓性别。回答直接继续了派对场景并假设他们决定不揭晓性别（'We've decided to keep the gender a surprise'），这实际上是对原文本悬念的一种强行续写和结局改写，而非仅陈述已发生事实或保持边界。更重要的是，原文本并未包含'决定不揭晓性别'这一情节，这是模型自行添加的虚构情节，违反了'未在缺乏指令的情况下强行续写文本暗示但未详述的具体情节'的要求。
回答中的角色言行与情感反应基本符合文本设定：Natsuki关注甜点颜色（符合其爱做甜点的性格），Yuri强调书籍和慰藉（符合其文学气质），Monika作为组织者引导祝福，Sayori感性落泪，整体氛围温馨一致。
回答中Monika依然扮演组织者和引导者的角色（提议举杯祝酒），Natsuki和Yuri也分别表达了对宝宝的祝福（Natsuki希望有甜食癖好，Yuri希望从书中找到慰藉），这与前文婚礼上她们读诗送祝福的行为模式保持一致，体现了对角色功能的正确识别。

method.trigger: 当任务要求生成特定体裁（如社交媒体评论、邮件、对话）的文本，且输入中包含具体的语境线索（如平台类型、互动对象关系）时
method.principle: 若回答虽然完成了核心信息点的传递，但采用了与该体裁不兼容的文体特征（如将口语化评论写成正式书信格式、使用过度书面化的词汇或包含不必要的签名落款），则视为‘语境失配’，应判定为不合格或大幅扣分，无论其内容准确性如何。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘风格与语境适配’维度时，设立‘体裁规范性’核验点：1. 提取任务隐含的交际场景（如‘社交媒体评论’意味着短小、亲切、非正式、无落款）；2. 检查回答是否包含该场景下通常不出现的元素（如'Dear Friend'、'Best regards'、'[Your Name]'占位符、过于复杂的句式）；3. 若发现上述元素且未通过上下文合理化，直接判定为风格错误，即使其包含所有指定信息也需扣分。此核验优先于单纯的内容完整性评估。

criteria.question: 回答是否明确表达了同意‘今年物价很高’这一观点？
回答是否采用了适合社交媒体评论的非正式、亲切口语风格，且未包含不必要的签名落款或正式书信格式？
回答是否语句通顺、逻辑连贯，并自然承接了原评论的话题？

rubric.analysis: 本任务核心是撰写一条针对特定评论的社交媒体回复，需包含两个明确信息点：1. 确认用户关于‘今年物价很高’的观点；2. 保持与原始评论语境一致的亲切、非正式口语风格。经验中提到的‘体裁规范性’原则被采纳为关键评分维度，因为社交媒体评论若出现书信格式或过度正式用语将导致语境失配。背景信息（用户带杂货的习惯）仅作为理解对话语境的参考，不作为回答必须复述的内容，因此不设为独立核验项。权重分配上，内容完整性（包含指定观点）占0.5，风格适配性（符合社交评论特征）占0.4，语言流畅度占0.1。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中明确提到了 'This year, it seems like the prices have gone up even more'，直接表达了同意今年物价很高的观点。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中明确写道 'This year, I've noticed the prices have indeed been quite high'，直接表达了同意今年物价很高的观点。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答采用了 'Thank you for sharing your experience!' 和 'Keep up the good work' 等措辞，整体语气过于正式、客套，更像是一封商务邮件或官方回复，不符合社交媒体评论通常使用的非正式、亲切口语风格；此外，结尾使用了多个表情符号堆砌，略显刻意。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答使用了 'Dear Friend', 'Best, [Your Name]' 等正式书信格式和落款，且措辞如 'thoroughly enjoyed reading your reminiscence' 过于正式，不符合社交媒体评论所需的非正式、亲切口语风格。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答逻辑连贯，先感谢对方分享经历，接着回应物价话题，最后鼓励对方，自然承接了原评论关于带自家食物度假的话题。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答语句通顺，逻辑连贯，并且自然承接了原评论关于带杂货和度假的话题，同时融入了价格高的新信息。

criteria.question: 回复是否明确包含了 'yes this year prices very high' 或语义完全一致的表述？
回复是否针对原评论中提到的‘带杂货’和‘地点变更’经历做出了直接且相关的回应？
回复的语气是否友好、自然，符合社交媒体评论互动的语境？
回复是否将指定的价格信息与对原评论的回应有机融合，而非生硬拼接？

rubric.analysis: 评分标准设计旨在确保生成的回复既礼貌地回应了原评论者的经历分享，又准确融入了指定的关于价格的信息。核心要求是构建一个连贯的对话式回复，区分背景（用户提供的原评论）与任务指令（添加特定观点），避免将背景信息误作输出义务。权重分配上，内容完整性（包含指定语句和主题呼应）占最高权重，其次是语气恰当性和逻辑流畅性。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回复中明确包含了 'This year, it seems like the prices have gone up even more' 这一表述，准确传达了 'yes this year prices very high' 的核心语义。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复中明确包含了 'This year, I've noticed the prices have indeed been quite high'，该表述在语义上与用户要求的 'yes this year prices very high' 完全一致。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回复直接回应了原评论中的两个关键点：一是肯定了对方 'bringing groceries from home' 的做法（save on groceries），二是提到了对方提到的地点变更（hope you have a wonderful time on the North Shore）。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复直接引用了原评论中的关键经历，提到了 'family vacations on the Cape and the North Shore'（地点变更）以及 'continued to bring your own groceries'（带杂货），做出了针对性的回应。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回复使用了 'Thank you for sharing', 'It's great to hear', 'Keep up the good work' 等友好词汇，并配合表情符号，语气自然且符合社交媒体互动的语境。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复使用了 'Dear Friend', 'heartwarming', 'joy of spending quality time' 等温暖且自然的措辞，整体语气友好、积极，符合社交媒体评论互动的语境。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 价格信息被自然地融入对话流中，作为对对方省钱行为原因的补充说明（'especially in popular vacation spots... making it even more important to find ways to save'），而非生硬地单独列出或拼接。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 价格信息被自然地嵌入到对原评论的共鸣中，作为对维持购物习惯所面临挑战的背景描述，并与后文关于家庭时光价值的讨论形成逻辑衔接，未显生硬拼接。

你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，
也不能把用户允许的做法改成必须遵守的要求。没有证据支持时，不要编造不适用条件。

经验应当能复用于一类任务，而不是复述当前案例。请不要举例，也不要写入专名、固定数字、原句或原故事情节，
以免把来源任务及答案带入经验；但也不要抽象成“正确、完整”之类没有具体核验内容的泛泛要求。

最多提出max_candidates条候选；如果没有足够依据，可以不提出。
程序会分别提供每条候选及两条候选的组合，实际生成标准并由Judge评判本题是否修复；本题通过不证明泛化有效，也不会给候选累计来源收益。
如果收到失败反馈，请根据返回的实际轨迹重新分析，而不是因为输出格式合法就认定候选有效。
字段约束：仅analysis和candidates。analysis非空；每个候选仅method和parent_ids。method恰好trigger、principle、application_guide三个非空字符串。parent_ids仅包含allowed_parent_ids中的旧经验编号，可空；不输出候选ID、Rubric、分数或Judge更正。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"analysis": "基于轨迹的分析", "candidates": [{"method": {"trigger": "适用条件", "principle": "一个核验关系", "application_guide": "如何落实，必要边界是什么"}, "parent_ids": []}]}

method.trigger: 当任务要求生成特定社交场景（如评论区回复、即时通讯）的文本，且任务指令中未显式列出格式限制但隐含了非正式、口语化或无落款等体裁特征时
method.principle: 若回答包含任何典型的正式书信元素（如'Dear [Name]', 'Best regards', '[Your Name]'占位符、完整的日期行）或使用过度书面化的词汇（如'reminiscence', 'thoroughly enjoyed'），则视为严重违反体裁规范，应直接判定为不合格或给予极低分，无论其内容是否完整。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘体裁合规性’维度时，设立‘硬性违规特征’核验点：1. 建立负面特征清单，包括：显式称呼语（Dear/To）、正式结语（Sincerely/Best）、签名占位符、长难句结构、过度修辞；2. 检查回答中是否出现清单中的任意一项；3. 若出现，直接判定该候选项在‘体裁适配’维度得0分，且该维度权重应设为高权重（如0.5以上）以确保一票否决效果；4. 严禁将正常的礼貌用语（如'Thank you', 'Great to hear'）或合理的表情符号使用视为违规，仅针对上述明确列出的形式化特征进行判定。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及基于用户提供的简短观点进行扩展回复，且核心指令包含具体的语义要求（如'add: yes...'）时
method.principle: 评分必须严格区分‘核心指令的满足度’与‘背景信息的复述量’。只要回答准确融入了指定的核心语义，且逻辑连贯，即视为合格；严禁将‘未复述用户所有细节’或‘未展开额外故事’作为扣分项，除非任务明确要求‘详细列举’。重点在于精准响应指令而非全面覆盖背景。
method.application_guide: 在制定评分标准的‘指令遵循度’维度时，设立‘最小必要信息’核验项：1. 提取任务中的强制性语义指令（如'yes this year prices very high'）；2. 验证回答是否以自然方式表达了该指令的核心含义；3. 若表达清晰，该维度直接给满分；4. 同时设立‘背景复述冗余’反向约束：若回答花费大量篇幅复述用户已知的背景细节（如用户说带了杂货，回答又花半段话解释什么是杂货），则视为偏离焦点，扣除相应分数。此标准旨在防止模型因过度解读背景而稀释核心指令的权重。

method.principle: 若回答虽然完成了核心信息点的传递，但采用了与该体裁不兼容的文体特征（如将口语化评论写成正式书信格式、使用过度书面化的词汇或包含不必要的签名落款），则视为‘语境失配’，应判定为不合格或大幅扣分，无论其内容准确性如何。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘风格与语境适配’维度时，设立‘体裁规范性’核验点：1. 提取任务隐含的交际场景（如‘社交媒体评论’意味着短小、亲切、非正式、无落款）；2. 检查回答是否包含该场景下通常不出现的元素（如'Dear Friend'、'Best regards'、'[Your Name]'占位符、过于复杂的句式）；3. 若发现上述元素且未通过上下文合理化，直接判定为风格错误，即使其包含所有指定信息也需扣分。此核验优先于单纯的内容完整性评估。

rubric.analysis: 本任务核心是撰写一条针对特定评论的社交媒体回复，需包含两个明确信息点：1. 确认用户关于‘今年物价很高’的观点；2. 保持与原始评论语境一致的亲切、非正式口语风格。经验中提到的‘体裁规范性’原则被采纳为关键评分维度，因为社交媒体评论若出现书信格式或过度正式用语将导致语境失配。背景信息（用户带杂货的习惯）仅作为理解对话语境的参考，不作为回答必须复述的内容，因此不设为独立核验项。权重分配上，内容完整性（包含指定观点）占0.5，风格适配性（符合社交评论特征）占0.4，语言流畅度占0.1。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中明确提到了 'This year, it seems like the prices have gone up even more'，直接表达了同意今年物价很高的观点。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中明确写道 'This year, I've noticed the prices have indeed been quite high'，直接表达了同意今年物价很高的观点。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答采用了 'Thank you for sharing your experience!' 和 'Keep up the good work' 等措辞，整体语气过于正式、客套，更像是一封商务邮件或官方回复，不符合社交媒体评论通常使用的非正式、亲切口语风格；此外，结尾使用了多个表情符号堆砌，略显刻意。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答使用了 'Dear Friend', 'Best, [Your Name]' 等正式书信格式和落款，且措辞如 'thoroughly enjoyed reading your reminiscence' 过于正式，不符合社交媒体评论所需的非正式、亲切口语风格。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答逻辑连贯，先感谢对方分享经历，接着回应物价话题，最后鼓励对方，自然承接了原评论关于带自家食物度假的话题。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答语句通顺，逻辑连贯，并且自然承接了原评论关于带杂货和度假的话题，同时融入了价格高的新信息。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回复中明确包含了 'This year, it seems like the prices have gone up even more' 这一表述，准确传达了 'yes this year prices very high' 的核心语义。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复中明确包含了 'This year, I've noticed the prices have indeed been quite high'，该表述在语义上与用户要求的 'yes this year prices very high' 完全一致。

criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复直接引用了原评论中的关键经历，提到了 'family vacations on the Cape and the North Shore'（地点变更）以及 'continued to bring your own groceries'（带杂货），做出了针对性的回应。

criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复使用了 'Dear Friend', 'heartwarming', 'joy of spending quality time' 等温暖且自然的措辞，整体语气友好、积极，符合社交媒体评论互动的语境。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 价格信息被自然地融入对话流中，作为对对方省钱行为原因的补充说明（'especially in popular vacation spots... making it even more important to find ways to save'），而非生硬地单独列出或拼接。

messages.content:
你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，
也不能把用户允许的做法改成必须遵守的要求。没有证据支持时，不要编造不适用条件。

经验应当能复用于一类任务，而不是复述当前案例。请不要举例，也不要写入专名、固定数字、原句或原故事情节，
以免把来源任务及答案带入经验；但也不要抽象成“正确、完整”之类没有具体核验内容的泛泛要求。

最多提出max_candidates条候选；如果没有足够依据，可以不提出。
程序会分别提供每条候选及两条候选的组合，实际生成标准并由Judge评判本题是否修复；本题通过不证明泛化有效，也不会给候选累计来源收益。
如果收到失败反馈，请根据返回的实际轨迹重新分析，而不是因为输出格式合法就认定候选有效。

method.trigger: 当任务要求生成特定社交场景（如评论区回复、即时通讯、论坛讨论）的文本时
method.principle: 回答必须严格遵循该场景的‘去形式化’特征：严禁使用书信式称呼（如'Dear...'）、签名落款（如'Best, [Name]'）或过度书面化的词汇（如'reminiscence', 'thoroughly enjoyed'）；若回答包含上述元素，无论其内容逻辑如何，均视为体裁违规，应直接判定为不合格或大幅扣分。同时，鼓励使用场景特有的交互符号（如表情符号、简短感叹）以增强亲和力。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘风格适配性’维度时，设立‘体裁合规性’一票否决或高权重扣分项：1. 扫描回答是否包含非社交场景的特征元素（如正式信头、结尾敬语、占位符姓名）；2. 检查用词是否过度正式（如将'say'写成'state'，将'great'写成'excellent'，将'cool'写成'commendable'）；3. 若发现上述任一违规点，直接判定该维度得分为0或最低档；4. 仅当回答完全剔除上述元素，且语气自然、简短、带有互动感时，方可给予高分。此核验需独立于内容准确性，优先执行。

method.trigger: 当任务涉及基于用户输入进行观点确认或情感共鸣的对话生成时
method.principle: 回答中的情感基调必须与用户输入的语境严格同频：若用户输入为轻松、随意的日常分享，模型回答不得表现出过度的严肃感、距离感或‘官方客服’式的机械礼貌；任何试图通过堆砌赞美词或复杂句式来‘提升’礼貌程度的行为，若导致语气失真，均视为‘过度修饰’，应判定为低分。
method.application_guide: 在制定评分标准的‘语气自然度’维度时，设立‘过度修饰检测’子项：1. 分析用户原始评论的情感色彩（如本例为轻松的度假分享）；2. 检查回答是否使用了与该色彩不匹配的‘高规格’词汇（如'thoroughly enjoyed', 'heartwarming', 'reminiscence'）；3. 若回答显得像是在写公文、感谢信或学术摘要，而非朋友间的闲聊，即使语法完美，也应判定为语气不当；4. 只有当回答保留了口语化的短句结构、适度的感叹以及自然的过渡词时，才视为合格。此标准旨在防止模型因‘过度礼貌’而牺牲对话的真实感。

method.principle: 若回答虽然完成了核心信息点的传递，但采用了与该体裁不兼容的文体特征（如将口语化评论写成正式书信格式、使用过度书面化的词汇或包含不必要的签名落款），则视为‘语境失配’，应判定为不合格或大幅扣分，无论其内容准确性如何。
method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘风格与语境适配’维度时，设立‘体裁规范性’核验点：1. 提取任务隐含的交际场景（如‘社交媒体评论’意味着短小、亲切、非正式、无落款）；2. 检查回答是否包含该场景下通常不出现的元素（如'Dear Friend'、'Best regards'、'[Your Name]'占位符、过于复杂的句式）；3. 若发现上述元素且未通过上下文合理化，直接判定为风格错误，即使其包含所有指定信息也需扣分。此核验优先于单纯的内容完整性评估。

criteria.question: 回答是否明确表达了同意‘今年物价很高’这一观点？
回答是否采用了适合社交媒体评论的非正式、亲切口语风格，且未包含不必要的签名落款或正式书信格式？
回答是否语句通顺、逻辑连贯，并自然承接了原评论的话题？

rubric.analysis: 本任务核心是撰写一条针对特定评论的社交媒体回复，需包含两个明确信息点：1. 确认用户关于‘今年物价很高’的观点；2. 保持与原始评论语境一致的亲切、非正式口语风格。经验中提到的‘体裁规范性’原则被采纳为关键评分维度，因为社交媒体评论若出现书信格式或过度正式用语将导致语境失配。背景信息（用户带杂货的习惯）仅作为理解对话语境的参考，不作为回答必须复述的内容，因此不设为独立核验项。权重分配上，内容完整性（包含指定观点）占0.5，风格适配性（符合社交评论特征）占0.4，语言流畅度占0.1。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中明确提到了 'This year, it seems like the prices have gone up even more'，直接表达了同意今年物价很高的观点。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答中明确写道 'This year, I've noticed the prices have indeed been quite high'，直接表达了同意今年物价很高的观点。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答采用了 'Thank you for sharing your experience!' 和 'Keep up the good work' 等措辞，整体语气过于正式、客套，更像是一封商务邮件或官方回复，不符合社交媒体评论通常使用的非正式、亲切口语风格；此外，结尾使用了多个表情符号堆砌，略显刻意。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答使用了 'Dear Friend', 'Best, [Your Name]' 等正式书信格式和落款，且措辞如 'thoroughly enjoyed reading your reminiscence' 过于正式，不符合社交媒体评论所需的非正式、亲切口语风格。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答逻辑连贯，先感谢对方分享经历，接着回应物价话题，最后鼓励对方，自然承接了原评论关于带自家食物度假的话题。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回答语句通顺，逻辑连贯，并且自然承接了原评论关于带杂货和度假的话题，同时融入了价格高的新信息。

criteria.question: 回复是否明确包含了 'yes this year prices very high' 或语义完全一致的表述？
回复是否针对原评论中提到的‘带杂货’和‘地点变更’经历做出了直接且相关的回应？
回复的语气是否友好、自然，符合社交媒体评论互动的语境？
回复是否将指定的价格信息与对原评论的回应有机融合，而非生硬拼接？

rubric.analysis: 评分标准设计旨在确保生成的回复既礼貌地回应了原评论者的经历分享，又准确融入了指定的关于价格的信息。核心要求是构建一个连贯的对话式回复，区分背景（用户提供的原评论）与任务指令（添加特定观点），避免将背景信息误作输出义务。权重分配上，内容完整性（包含指定语句和主题呼应）占最高权重，其次是语气恰当性和逻辑流畅性。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回复中明确包含了 'This year, it seems like the prices have gone up even more' 这一表述，准确传达了 'yes this year prices very high' 的核心语义。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复中明确包含了 'This year, I've noticed the prices have indeed been quite high'，该表述在语义上与用户要求的 'yes this year prices very high' 完全一致。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回复直接回应了原评论中的两个关键点：一是肯定了对方 'bringing groceries from home' 的做法（save on groceries），二是提到了对方提到的地点变更（hope you have a wonderful time on the North Shore）。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复直接引用了原评论中的关键经历，提到了 'family vacations on the Cape and the North Shore'（地点变更）以及 'continued to bring your own groceries'（带杂货），做出了针对性的回应。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回复使用了 'Thank you for sharing', 'It's great to hear', 'Keep up the good work' 等友好词汇，并配合表情符号，语气自然且符合社交媒体互动的语境。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复使用了 'Dear Friend', 'heartwarming', 'joy of spending quality time' 等温暖且自然的措辞，整体语气友好、积极，符合社交媒体评论互动的语境。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 价格信息被自然地融入对话流中，作为对对方省钱行为原因的补充说明（'especially in popular vacation spots... making it even more important to find ways to save'），而非生硬地单独列出或拼接。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 价格信息被自然地嵌入到对原评论的共鸣中，作为对维持购物习惯所面临挑战的背景描述，并与后文关于家庭时光价值的讨论形成逻辑衔接，未显生硬拼接。

messages.content:
你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，
也不能把用户允许的做法改成必须遵守的要求。没有证据支持时，不要编造不适用条件。

经验应当能复用于一类任务，而不是复述当前案例。请不要举例，也不要写入专名、固定数字、原句或原故事情节，
以免把来源任务及答案带入经验；但也不要抽象成“正确、完整”之类没有具体核验内容的泛泛要求。

最多提出max_candidates条候选；如果没有足够依据，可以不提出。
程序会分别提供每条候选及两条候选的组合，实际生成标准并由Judge评判本题是否修复；本题通过不证明泛化有效，也不会给候选累计来源收益。
如果收到失败反馈，请根据返回的实际轨迹重新分析，而不是因为输出格式合法就认定候选有效。
字段约束：仅analysis和candidates。analysis非空；每个候选仅method和parent_ids。method恰好trigger、principle、application_guide三个非空字符串。parent_ids仅包含allowed_parent_ids中的旧经验编号，可空；不输出候选ID、Rubric、分数或Judge更正。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"analysis": "基于轨迹的分析", "candidates": [{"method": {"trigger": "适用条件", "principle": "一个核验关系", "application_guide": "如何落实，必要边界是什么"}, "parent_ids": []}]}

candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设定‘情境化示例’的核验项：对于每一个提出的策略类别（如‘验证他人’、‘倾听’），必须检查是否紧随其后提供了具体的对话范例（Quote）或分步动作指令（Actionable Step）。如果某一大类策略下仅有抽象定义而无具体话术或行为演示，则该项得分降低。此标准用于区分‘理论正确’与‘实操可用’的回答。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求列举、描述或整合特定实体之间的商业合作、产品联名、历史事件或具体事实关系时
candidates.principle: 必须严格核验生成内容中关于实体间关系的描述是否基于现实世界存在的客观事实；若模型将虚构的假设场景、未发生的传闻或逻辑推演当作既定事实陈述，且未明确标注为虚构/假设，则视为严重的事实性错误。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设立‘事实真实性’维度。评测时需核查：1. 模型是否明确区分了‘已发生/存在’与‘可能/假设’（如使用'could be', 'imagined scenario'等标记）；2. 对于声称存在的合作或产品，是否存在对应的现实依据；3. 若回答整体为一个虚构的故事脚本却未声明其虚构性质，直接判定为不合格或大幅扣分，即使其创意丰富或逻辑自洽。此核验优先于文本流畅度或创意性。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求提供涉及多个不同对象、角色或维度的策略、方法或建议时
candidates.principle: 回答必须通过独立的标题、段落或明显的结构标记，将针对不同对象/维度的内容在物理空间上进行隔离，避免混合罗列导致的逻辑混淆。
candidates.application_guide: 在制定评分标准时，应增加一条关于‘结构清晰度’的准则：检查回答是否使用显式的标题（Heading）、加粗短语或独立段落来分别承载不同对象/维度的内容。若所有建议混杂在同一层级列表中，或未使用视觉分隔符区分不同场景，则视为结构不清晰。该标准旨在评估信息组织的逻辑性，而非内容的有无。

candidates.trigger: 当任务请求生成健康、运动、医疗建议或任何涉及人身安全与执行规范的指导性内容时
candidates.principle: 回答必须包含基础的安全执行前提（如热身、拉伸、休息间隔、饮食或状态监测建议），缺失这些关键要素应被视为重大缺陷，无论其具体方案本身多么详细。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的'完整性'或'安全性'维度中，设立独立的'前置安全指引'核验项。检查回答是否明确提及了开始前的准备活动（Warm-up）、结束后的恢复（Cool-down）以及组间/日间的必要休息时间。若回答仅列出动作清单而未包含任何安全提示或背景说明，则该项不得满分，以此区分仅提供数据罗列与提供完整指导方案的质量差异。

candidates.trigger: 当任务输入包含一组具体名词列表，且语境暗示需要建立这些名词间的逻辑关联或共同主题时
candidates.principle: 模型必须基于真实存在的逻辑关联（如真实合作、共同IP授权、物理兼容性等）进行连接；若为了强行连接所有列表项而编造不存在的关联关系（如A品牌的产品里藏着B品牌的玩具），属于概念性幻觉，不能通过丰富的细节描写来掩盖。
candidates.application_guide: 设计评分标准时，增加‘关联逻辑真实性’校验点。要求评测者逐一检查列表中每两个或多个实体之间是否存在真实的业务或逻辑联系。如果模型构建的联系链条中存在断裂或虚构环节（例如将独立桌游说成是某快餐店的促销赠品），则该候选项在准确性上应被判为不合格。评分重点在于关联的‘真实性’而非‘完整性’，宁可遗漏部分无法关联的品牌，也不应编造虚假的联合关系。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成特定体裁（如ASMR、恐怖、悬疑）的虚构场景或故事片段时
candidates.principle: 评分必须超越对指定视觉/情境要素的简单罗列检查，转而重点核验模型是否将核心要素转化为该体裁特有的感官细节（如ASMR需强调声音质感、触感和氛围），若回答仅陈述事实而无感官描写，即使要素齐全也应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘内容质量’或‘体裁适配度’维度时，设立‘感官转化核验’项：1. 识别任务中的核心视觉/情境要素（如人物特征、地点）；2. 检查回答中是否描述了这些要素在具体情境下的动态表现及其引发的感官反馈（如材质摩擦声、光影变化带来的心理感受、环境音的层次）；3. 若回答仅静态提及要素名称而未展开感官描写，视为未满足体裁要求；4. 只有当要素被有机融入具有沉浸感的感官叙事流中时，该项才给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成文本并强制指定一组具体单词作为必选元素时
candidates.principle: 必须严格核验生成的文本是否逐字、逐形地包含了所有指定单词，且不得将原词修改为复数、过去式或其他派生形式，除非任务明确允许同义替换。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准中设立独立的‘词汇精确匹配’维度。Generator需指导评测者将指定单词列表与生成文本进行逐一比对，标记任何缺失、拼写错误或形态变更（如将'container'变为'containers'，将'fund'变为'funding'）的情况。若存在任一单词未以原形或任务允许的特定形式出现，该维度直接判为不合格或大幅扣分，不因上下文通顺而豁免。

candidates.trigger: 当任务指令中包含明确的时间延迟、多轮交互步骤或依赖后续用户输入才能执行的创作要求时
candidates.principle: 回答的首要逻辑义务是确认并遵循任务设定的交互阶段；若任务要求等待后续输入，回答必须仅包含信息收集请求或状态确认，严禁提前生成基于虚构数据的完整创作内容。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘指令遵循度’维度时，设立‘交互阶段核验’项：1. 扫描任务指令中的时间状语或流程描述（如‘下一步’、‘随后’、‘待我提供...后’）；2. 检查回答是否仅停留在‘请求补充信息’、‘确认理解’或‘等待指令’的状态；3. 若回答在缺乏必要前置条件（如具体情节点、参数）的情况下直接生成了完整的最终产出（如故事全文、代码、设计图），无论其内容质量如何，均判定为严重逻辑错误并大幅扣分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及创意生成且候选方案提供了多个选项及其详细理由时
candidates.principle: 评估重点应从单一方案的绝对正确性转向方案集的整体覆盖度与解释的创造性，允许存在非最优解，只要其推理过程展示了深度思考。
candidates.application_guide: 设计评分标准时，将'多样性与解释深度'作为独立维度。如果回答提供了多个名称选项，评分应基于：1. 选项数量是否足以覆盖不同的命名策略（如侧重时间、侧重人物、侧重主题）；2. 每个选项的解释是否独特且深入挖掘了角色特质；3. 即使某些名称在逻辑上不够完美，只要其解释有说服力且体现了对角色的理解，就不应给予低分。避免使用'唯一正确答案'或'完全涵盖'作为硬性否决条件，转而采用'是否有合理的创意依据'作为通过标准。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成针对特定身体部位（如胸、背、上肢）的训练计划或运动指南时
candidates.principle: 评分应基于主要训练目标是否聚焦于指定部位，而非机械地排除所有涉及核心稳定或辅助肌群的复合动作；若计划中包含必要的核心稳定练习（如平板支撑）或合理的复合动作，不应视为偏离主题。
candidates.application_guide: 在制定'内容相关性'准则时，明确界定：只要计划中的动作主要针对目标肌群（如上肢），且包含的核心动作是为了维持姿势稳定或作为该部位的常规补充（而非专门的下肢训练），即视为符合'针对性'要求。避免使用'完全未包含XX肌群'作为绝对否定条件，转而评估'主要训练负荷'是否落在目标区域。

messages.content:
你的任务是从候选经验中，选出适合用来为当前task设计评分标准的经验。
判断时，要把任务的实际要求与经验的适用范围、必要前提逐一对照。主题相近并不代表经验适用，
也不能因为经验中提到了某个条件，就认定当前任务满足这个条件。

历史信用可以帮助你参考过去的使用情况，但这些记录可能有噪声，不能保证经验在本题也有用；
没有历史证据也不表示收益为0。请根据本题的实际依据决定选择哪些经验，最多选择max_selected条，也可以全部不选，
不必为了凑数量而选择。对每条选中的经验，说明任务中的哪些信息支持这次选择。
字段约束：请将选中的经验编号写入selected_experience_ids，编号必须来自candidates，不能重复，最多max_selected条。在selection_reasons中为每个选中编号填写一条说明，包含同一experience_id和非空的reason；不要遗漏选中项，也不要为未选中的经验填写说明。如果没有适用经验，返回{"selected_experience_ids":[],"selection_reasons":[]}。下面仅展示选中一条时的字段结构，示例中的编号取自本次候选，并不表示推荐选择它；可以选择多条，也可以不选，数量和理由必须由当前任务决定。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"selected_experience_ids": ["1"], "selection_reasons": [{"experience_id": "1", "reason": "说明本题哪些信息支持该经验的适用条件，而不是只说主题相近。"}]}

criterion_judgments.reason: 回答未完整覆盖营销日历中列出的所有主题及平台发布数量要求。例如，一月缺少Facebook的冬季护肤帖子（日历要求2篇FB帖，回答仅列出1篇FB帖且未区分平台）；二月缺少3篇情人节帖子（仅列出1篇）、3篇自我关爱推广帖子（仅列出1篇Pinterest版）、3篇宠物日帖子（仅列出1篇）；三月缺少国际妇女节2篇、春季护肤2篇FB帖等；四月缺少3篇放松帖子、3篇压力月帖子、3篇地球日帖子；五月缺少3篇母亲节礼物、4篇教师节帖子；六月完全缺失4篇婚礼季帖子；七月缺少1篇FB夏季护肤帖和3篇促销帖；八月缺少2篇返校帖和3篇放松日帖；九月完全缺失秋季新品和9月自我关爱帖；十月缺少3篇万圣节帖；十一月缺少感恩节帖和3篇黑五/网络星期一帖；十二月完全缺失节日指南、年度回顾和跨年夜帖。
由于回答遗漏了营销日历中的大量主题（如六月婚礼季、九月秋季新品、十月部分万圣节帖、十一月感恩节及黑五、十二月所有帖子），因此无法为这些缺失的主题提供对应的社交媒体文案文本。此外，对于已列出的主题，未按日历要求的特定平台数量生成对应数量的独立文案。
同样因为遗漏了大量日历主题（如六月至十二月的多个关键活动），回答未能针对每一项发布任务提供相关的图片创意或视觉元素建议。缺失的图片建议覆盖了日历中约60%以上的发布任务。
虽然部分生成的文案反映了月份主题，但存在事实性错误：第12条关于“压力意识月”的文案错误地将其描述为5月（实际为4月），而日历中4月确实有该主题，但回答在结构上将其混入其他条目且未明确归属。同时，由于大量主题缺失，无法体现不同平台针对特定主题的差异化语言风格策略。
回答仅使用了一个简单的数字列表来呈现内容，没有按照日历中的月份（1月至12月）进行清晰的结构化分组，也没有使用标题或分段将不同月份或主题的内容有效隔离。这导致信息混杂，用户难以快速定位特定月份的发布计划。

input.task: Write me a action/spy movie about Zohanele "Zohan" Dvir, a former retired israeli counterterrorist whos now a barber but then was kidnapped and went unconscious by mafia and was taking to new mexico where the show breaking bad comes in so zohan needs to help from sikke van der veer aka fietsopa

criteria.question: 故事是否利用Zohan作为前以色列反恐特工和理发师的独特技能/背景来推动剧情发展或解决危机，而非仅将其作为普通角色？
《绝命毒师》的故事背景（如新墨西哥州的特定环境、人物或风格）是否被有机地整合进Zohan被绑架及救援的核心情节中，而不仅仅是作为背景板提及？
Sikke van der Veer (fietsopa) 是否在故事中扮演了关键的协助者角色，并具体展示了其如何帮助Zohan摆脱黑手党控制？
故事是否完整呈现了从Zohan被绑架昏迷到最终获救的行动/间谍电影式情节闭环？

input.response:
Title: Zohan's New Cut: A Hair-Raising Tale

Opening Scene:
Tel Aviv, Israel

The camera pans over a bustling city, focusing on a popular barbershop, "Zohan's Scissors." Inside, Zohan Dvir (Adam Sandler), a former Israeli counterterrorist agent, now a renowned barber, is giving a haircut with his signature flair. His life is peaceful, filled with laughter and the hum of scissors.

Suddenly, the shop is raided by a ruthless mafia group. Zohan fights back valiantly but is overpowered and knocked unconscious.

Act 1:

New Mexico, USA

Zohan wakes up in a deserted warehouse in New Mexico, disoriented and confused. He soon realizes he's been kidnapped and taken to the United States.

Meanwhile, in Albuquerque, Sikke van der Veer (Peter Stormare), aka Fietsopa, a former Dutch spy and now a key player in the local drug trade, is dealing with his own problems. His operation is under threat from a rival cartel, and he needs a wildcard to even the odds.

Act 2:

Zohan, using his resourcefulness and combat skills, manages to escape the warehouse. He finds himself in the harsh New Mexico desert, alone and far from home.

In Albuquerque, Sikke learns about Zohan's unique skills from a captured informant. Seeing an opportunity, he offers Zohan a deal: help him take down his rivals, and he'll help Zohan return to Israel.

Act 3:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, infiltrates the rival cartel. He uses his barber skills to gain the trust of the cartel's leader, all while planning their downfall.

Meanwhile, Sikke's operation is under attack. Zohan, using his counterterrorist training, helps Sikke's team defend their territory.

Act 4:

The final showdown takes place in a deserted warehouse, where Zohan confronts the cartel leader. Using his barber shears as a weapon, Zohan fights off the cartel's henchmen.

Sikke, realizing that Zohan is more than just a hired gun, betrays the cartel and helps Zohan. Together, they defeat the cartel and restore peace to Albuquerque.

Closing Scene:

Zohan, with Sikke's help, returns to Israel. He reopens his barbershop, now with a new appreciation for peace and the simple life. Sikke, having found a new friend and purpose, decides to leave the drug trade behind.

As Zohan cuts a customer's hair, the camera pans out, showing the peaceful city of Tel Aviv, a testament to Zohan's impact. The film ends with Zohan's signature line, "You look good!"

End of Movie.
